title: rust lichen-node test regression: rfc6554_route_crosses_two_relays panics InvalidSourceRoute
description: Pre-existing failure found while wiring b7z9.37.3.2 (reproduces with the wiring diff stashed): rust lichen-node rpl_stack::tests::rfc6554_route_crosses_two_relays_and_restores_packet panics at tests.rs:443 unwrap on Err(InvalidSourceRoute). Likely related to the recent util.rs/routing changes (cf. b7z9.4.2 egress decapsulation work touching survey_routing_headers, or another worker's merge). Investigate whether SRH validation became stricter than the test's fixture expects, or the fixture is stale; fix code or fixture per whichever is wrong. Note: fmt hunks in rpl_stack/util.rs (291/318/367) are deferred to kpv0.5 and clippy secure.rs:642 too_many_arguments is kpv0.6 scope — do not fix those here.
